subject.title: Discord thread reply after session done: silent message loss due to session-store CAS race, no retry unlike Telegram

question: Should this Discord-specific report wait on the shared self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920, or should maintainers also require Discord channel-level retry/requeue parity for `reply session initialization conflicted` errors?
rationale: The Discord drop path is source-backed, but the open shared self-heal may eliminate the CAS root cause before a channel-specific retry loop is worth adding to a hot channel path.

options.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
options.body: Treat the open shared self-heal PR as the primary fix path, then retest Discord thread follow-ups before adding Discord-specific retry logic.

options.title: Require Discord Retry Parity Now
options.body: Queue a separate Discord repair that classifies reply-session-init conflicts as retryable and preserves inbound jobs with bounded backoff.

options.title: Ask For Live Discord Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a current-main Discord thread timing repro before choosing between shared-root and channel-level fixes.

recommendation.title: Review Shared Self-Heal First
recommendation.body: Treat the open shared self-heal PR as the primary fix path, then retest Discord thread follow-ups before adding Discord-specific retry logic.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman authored the guarded reply-session initialization boundary and is the best available owner for the shared-vs-channel recovery decision.
